title: Shipping Policy
text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50; orders under $50 incur a $6.99 flat shipping fee. Expedited shipping (1-2 business days) is available for $19.99 on all categories except large furniture, which ships via scheduled freight delivery within 7-14 business days depending on region. Kitchen appliances over 10kg and all furniture items require a signature on delivery. International shipping is currently available to select regions only; delivery estimates and customs fees are shown at checkout.
